done_when: on a domain without a month field, a single month filter becomes the answer's period whatever partial period the model also sent; the open, last-1-month and end-only shapes seen live all reach the plant picker, and only a conflicting explicit from-to period is still rejected; leaves per shape

findings.body: The new regression test loops over all three windows inside one test and calls only `BedrockLlmProvider.select`. It therefore neither invokes the Ask flow nor asserts that `plantChoice` is returned, and the runner exposes one combined leaf instead of separate open-ended, end-only, and last-one-month leaves. The required plant-picker handoff could regress while this test remains green. Add separately named end-to-end leaves exercising each recorded shape through the real Ask entry point and asserting the picker.
findings.title: Not done: each partial-period shape reaches the plant picker in its own test leaf

why: Statement questions still fail when the model sends the month with an open, relative or end-only period
